mechanism: Tranylcypromine (MAOI) combined with armodafinil (sympathomimetic-like stimulant) increases risk of hypertensive crisis through potentiation of noradrenergic activity and inhibition of monoamine catabolism.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if clinically necessary, use with extreme caution, monitor blood pressure closely, and ensure patient education on dietary tyramine restriction and symptom recognition of hypertensive crisis.
